verified_key_information_units.information: Post-reporting events include extension of EUR 27 million loans maturing in 2026 to 2031 and Elenger Grupp's February 2026 acquisition of subsidiary SIA Mood Deco.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 14 (Events after the Reporting Date) details loan extension and Elenger acquisition announced on February 2, 2026.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K6, and K7 are PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K5 (Real estate segment infrastructure projects) and K8 (Post-reporting events including loan extensions and acquisition of SIA Mood Deco) are MISSING - no mention of Rail Baltica construction, Depo commercial space development, loan maturity extensions, or the February 2026 acquisition of SIA Mood Deco. The summary captures most HIGH-importance financial and operational results but omits two MEDIUM-importance items, resulting in a 'Generally yes' assessment.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of strong operational performance despite lower net profit due to one-off effects from prior year consolidation. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition. The summary flows logically from overall performance to specific metrics, segment results, and balance sheet improvements, with consistent explanations for variances (e.g., Tallink consolidation effects). All comparisons and relationships between figures are presented without internal inconsistency.
